decisions.reason: The construction site dumper is close to the firm's construction and industrial transport know-how, but it is less differentiated than its niche specialty equipment and so remains somewhat more exposed to pruning if sales stay modest.
The inclined furniture lift fits the firm's lifting, safety and service-oriented niche well, and a multi-model line is worth keeping as long as it supports a specialized installed base.

The inclined building material lift is a natural extension of the firm's construction lifting business and should be retained because it matches customer needs for reliable, easy-to-maintain jobsite equipment.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift is strategically compatible with the firm's lifting activities, though its narrower market and higher system complexity make it somewhat more vulnerable than the core lift lines.
